# Phase Two — Gevurah: Tree Resource Realism Constraints

The Awtsmoos renews sun and drought, root and sky; Awtsmoos.com gives each force a boundary so realism may deepen without letting one tree become many nearby.

## Hard invariants
1. One canonical skeleton remains the sole structural identity.
2. LOD/detail never generates a different biological tree.
3. `living.hydraulic` remains post-skeleton observation and must not alter the skeleton.
4. Only explicit pre-skeleton `development`, `environment`, succession, or habitat intent may change growth.
5. No duplicate hydraulic or seasonal subsystem may be invented.
6. Resource development must reuse moisture/fertility/heat vocabulary already used by living hydraulics.
7. Default calls with no development/environment intent remain unchanged.
8. Same seed + same environment remains deterministic.
9. Moisture/fertility/heat/soil depth/shade signals are bounded and immutable.
10. Resource support may scale crown, height, secondary branching, foliage, and trunk allocation only through existing config keys.
11. Drought cannot silently alter renderer LOD budgets.
12. Shade can strengthen light seeking but must not mutate light direction itself.
13. Wind continues through existing global-force and gnarliness vocabulary.
14. Caller-provided age/vigor/competition remain authoritative inputs.
15. Explicit development values override derived resource defaults where the same concept exists.
16. Tree preset configuration is cloned before mutation.
17. Touched source stays <=120 lines; split instead of compressing.
18. Every touched function gets meaningful JSDoc.
19. Tabs only.
20. Historical anatomy, biology-output, and living-manifest tests must remain green.
21. New tests must prove dry/moist structural divergence is deterministic.
22. New tests must prove post-skeleton hydraulic tuning still does not change skeleton identity.
23. New tests must prove geometry and every LOD bind to the resource-shaped skeleton hash.
24. No renderer or network side effects inside development modules.
25. Read back all touched files before claiming closure.

## Failure map
- Resource data added only to metadata -> realism is cosmetic.
- Living hydraulics reused as pre-skeleton state -> current compatibility contract breaks.
- Quality participates in development -> LOD identity diverges.
- Extra RNG consumption -> same seed changes unpredictably even with equivalent inputs.
- Monolithic development config -> future physiology becomes harder to extend.

## NEXT_ACTION
Implement resource development as a pure deterministic input to TreeDevelopmentProfile, then keep TreeDevelopmentConfig as the only structural application boundary.
